system.text:
Black Hunters know a little-known secret about Orc bile. It’s toxic to other creatures. A Hunter with this training may simply vomit on his arrows or knives to poison them before a fight. The vomit stays fresh for about a half hour before it loses its potency. No roll is required. Any creature who takes a Mark or Superb result hit from such a coated barb must pass an Ob 4 Health test. Margin of failure is added to all Health and Steel test obstacles taken for the rest of the day. This poison does not affect Orcs.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 3 pts.

Restrictions: Orcs only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 315
